name: Electrum Mouse Dragon
languages: understands Common and Draconic but can’t speak

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text:
The mouse dragon has advantage on an attack roll against
a creature if at least one of the dragon’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature
and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

traits.name: Treasure Sense
traits.text:
The mouse dragon can pinpoint, by scent, the location
of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 feet of it.

traits.name: Underfoot
traits.text:
The mouse dragon can attempt to hide even when it is
obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The electrum mouse dragon makes one bite attack and two
claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6
(1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text:
The dragon exhales lightning in a
20-foot line that is 1 foot wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC
12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) lightning damage on a failed
saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.
